---
title: "Paediatric brain injury biomarkers"
subtitle: "ISPN 2026, Cairo"
author: "Pete Laver"
date: today

format:
  revealjs:
    width: 1920
    height: 1080
    minScale: 0.5
    maxScale: 1.5
    output-file: ISPN_2026_Laver.html
    theme: [default, theme.scss]
    title-slide-attributes:
      data-background-image: "images/image4.png"
      data-background-size: "contain"
      data-background-position: "right"
    transition: none        # no slide-to-slide transitions
    slide-number: true
    controls: true
    hash: true
    embed-resources: true   # single self-contained html file, easy to share
    spotlight:
      useAsPointer: true
      pointerColor: "#ff0000"
      size: 12
      toggleSpotlightOnMouseDown: false
      initialPresentationMode: true
      presentingCursor: "default"
      spotlightCursor: "none"
      spotlightOnKeyPressAndHold: 73
    css: style.css
    include-in-header:
      - text: |
          <script src="script.js"></script>
  html:
    output-file: ISPN_2026_Rohlwink_notes.html
    toc: true
    number-sections: true
    embed-resources: true
    fig-align: center
    css: notes-style.css
revealjs-plugins:
  - spotlight
  - zoomit-ish

bibliography: references.bib

execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---
